important_changes.value: Q2 2026 total revenue was $3,333.9 million versus $2,964.7 million in Q2 2025; filing reports 12% growth.
H1 2026 total revenue was $6,320.8 million versus $5,734.9 million in H1 2025; filing reports 10% growth.

Q2 2026 TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO revenue decreased 2% year over year to $2,497.2 million; ALYFTREK increased 266% to $573.6 million; CASGEVY increased 151% to $76.4 million; JOURNAVX increased 313% to $49.6 million.

H1 2026 TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO revenue decreased 5% year over year to $4,851.9 million; ALYFTREK increased 374% to $998.0 million; CASGEVY increased 167% to $119.3 million; JOURNAVX increased 491% to $78.6 million.
CASGEVY Q2 2026 revenue increased 78% versus Q1 2026 and 151% versus Q2 2025.
important_changes.original_location: PDF p.24, Business Updates / Sickle Cell Disease and Beta Thalassemia

important_changes.value: JOURNAVX Q2 2026 revenue increased 71% versus Q1 2026 and more than 300% versus Q2 2025; approximately 535,000 prescriptions were filled in Q2 2026 and 900,000 in H1 2026.
important_changes.original_location: PDF p.24, Business Updates / Acute Pain

important_changes.value: The 2025 Form 10-K stated zimislecel dosing was temporarily postponed pending internal manufacturing analysis; the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q states Vertex is enrolling and dosing patients and expects to provide updated zimislecel/VX-017 timelines in 2026.
important_changes.original_location: 10-K Business overview / T1D; 10-Q PDF p.25 Type 1 Diabetes
important_changes.note: No inference is made regarding whether the prior manufacturing analysis was fully resolved.

risk_related_disclosures.value: The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q adds a risk factor that Vertex may be unable to complete the Crinetics acquisition, integrate Crinetics successfully, or realize expected commercial benefits. Risks include closing conditions, regulatory approvals, litigation, integration, retention, synergies, PALSONIFY commercial performance, and atumelnant development/approval/commercialization.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: PDF p.35, Part II Item 1A Risk Factors

risk_related_disclosures.value: Royalty Pharma arbitration alleges an approximately 8% ALYFTREK royalty burden versus Vertex's stated position of 4%, and seeks declaratory relief, alleged unpaid royalties, damages, costs, fees, and interest. Vertex states it intends to vigorously defend its position.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: PDF p.19, Legal Matters and Other Contingencies

risk_related_disclosures.value: As of June 30, 2026, Vertex stated there were no material loss contingencies accrued and no significant contingent liabilities accrued other than contingent consideration liabilities.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: PDF p.19, Legal Matters and Other Contingencies

risk_related_disclosures.value: The 2026 Revolver and 2026 Term Loan contain leverage covenants and restrictions; failure to comply may result in remedies including acceleration of outstanding loans.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: PDF pp.18 and 22, Note L / credit agreements

corporate_governance_and_management_even.value: Suketu Upadhyay withdrew from standing for re-election as a director at the 2026 annual meeting due to scheduling conflicts associated with his forthcoming CFO role at Incyte; Vertex stated the departure was not due to disagreement with company operations, policies, or practices. The Board intended to reduce its size to ten members.
corporate_governance_and_management_even.original_location: PDF p.2, Withdrawal of Nominee for Election as Director

corporate_governance_and_management_even.value: Jonathan Poole appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective January 1, 2027; Charles F. Wagner, Jr. will cease serving as CFO on that date but remain Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer.
Jonathan Poole's stated base salary is $750,000 with a target annual bonus of 90% of base salary as of the effective date.
